verdict.tagline: Essential aim training despite technical hiccups.
for_you_if: you want dedicated tools to sharpen your aim
not_for_you_if: you cannot tolerate random game freezes
you need a completely stable startup experience

cohorts.label: <2h refund window
cohorts.summary: Players encounter bugs that disrupt basic crosshair adjustments.

claims.claim: Reviewers report bugs preventing them from changing crosshairs.

citations.review_text: the first time I ran kovaaks it bombarded me with glitches I googled a lot of bugs and how to fix them. I would've probably spent more time troubleshooting than actually getting to aim train. (also why is it such a pain in the ass to add a custom crosshair)
cant change crosshairs due to a bug 8/10

cohorts.label: 2-20h
cohorts.summary: Players experience startup failures and server disconnects alongside extensive customization options.

claims.claim: Reviewers experience technical issues where the game freezes, reports servers as offline, or fails to start up entirely.

citations.review_text: Wanted to practice tracking, and now I can't, it just freezes and also says the servers are offline.
The Game doesnt start. Paid money for something that doesnt work. I shouldnt be expected to troubleshoot and fix something I paid for. I can understand doing it for pirated games.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the game as customizable with sound variety and settings that replicate other games.

citations.review_text:
Graphics- Not bad not the best but it is good for a aim trainer and it has no blur or anything that much. So I rate the graphics a 3/5.
Sounds- There is a lot of variety for the sounds so I would rate this a 4/5
Gameplay- Solid gameplay it can replicate so many games settings and the community maps are very good for practicing aim. So I rate the gameplay a 4/5
Overall this game is a solid 3/5 for aim training I recommend this game to people.
Customizability on another level for a aim trainer.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game freezes randomly and requires closing and restarting.

citations.review_text: This aim trainer always stood out from the others due to its various amount of tasks and customizability but for me its a bit crazy that this aim trainer costs money and is by far the most buggiest and laggiest of them all. There is no chance i can play benchmark without getting a message that servers are either unavailable or i have to contact support. Like what? and this is happening all the times, not just once, and its started to pissing me off that i cant play the game peacefully without it crashing. Its good aim trainer but its making me sad i had to pay money for something that is broken, when there is free alternatives that are better in optimization
Freezes a lot randomly. Have to close the game and restart.
